quick: 10 to 20 mL of the alginate-antacid liquid after meals and at bedtime
summary: Alginic acid and its salts form a viscous raft on top of gastric contents when combined with antacid, reducing reflux. Some products carry a high sodium load.

dosage.d: 10 to 20 mL of the alginate-antacid liquid after meals and at bedtime

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Forms a floating gel raft that acts as a mechanical barrier to reflux.

relative: Sodium-restricted patients (heart failure, renal or hepatic failure)

preg: Compatible; commonly used for pregnancy heartburn

moderate: Reduces absorption of tetracyclines, fluoroquinolones, iron, levothyroxine, digoxin, bisphosphonates and azole antifungals: separate by 2 to 4 hours

counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
refs: Martindale: The Complete Drug Reference (Pharmaceutical Press)
